paper_metadata.title: Vacuum brazing high Nb-containing TiAl alloy to Ti60 alloy using Ti-28Ni eutectic brazing alloy

evidence.quote: High Nb-containing TiAl alloy and Ti60 alloy was brazed successfully by vacuum brazing using Ti-28Ni eutectic brazing alloy.
As a near- α type titanium alloy, Ti60 alloy possesses excellent combination of mechanical and physical properties
Recently, Ti-28Ni (wt.%) eutectic brazing alloy was fabricated and used to braze high Nb-containing TiAl alloy

attributes.morphology: grey phase separated by retained beta phase at grain boundaries

evidence.quote: the original microstructure of Ti60 alloy consisted of primary α phase (grey phase) separated by retained β phase (white phase) which located at the grain bou ndaries.
the original microstructure of Ti60 alloy consisted of primary α phase (grey phase) separated by retained β phase (white phase) which located at the grain bou ndaries.
The microstructure of the TAN alloy was fully lamellar, as shown in Fig. 1a.

attributes.location: Zone I diffusion layer adjacent to Ti60 substrate

evidence.quote: Ni atoms in the filler metal diffusing into the Ti60 substrate caused the reduction of β-transition temperature of Ti60 alloy, leading to the transformation of α phase in Ti60 alloy into β phase in brazing process, and then β phase was transformed into Lamellar ( α+β) phase during cooling process
The atomic ratio of Ti and Ni of spot D in Zone II was about 2:1 (Fig. 4b), suggesting that the phase was δ-Ti 2Ni phase with width of ~ 40 µm.
The grey phase marked as spot C, E, F and G in Z one II and III also could be attributed to α-Ti phase
Spot I mainly contained Ti and Al with the molar ratio of 3:1, and the phase was i dentified as Ti 3Al.

attributes.location: Zone IV adjacent to TAN substrate

evidence.quote: the phase marked as spot J in Zone IV (Fig. 4a) was B2 phase according to the EDS results and Ref. [11, 20, 21].

attributes.location: Zone I adjacent to Ti60 substrate

evidence.quote: Zone I was the diffusion layer adjacent to the Ti60 substr ate and the strong dissolution of element Ni was occurred from molten filler to Ti60 substrate metal

evidence.section: 3.3 Effect of brazing temperature on the joint properties
evidence.quote: the crack initiated and propagated in the continuous Ti 2Ni phase during shear test when the brazing temperature was 1020 °C or 1040 °C, which proved the brittle characteristic of Ti 2Ni phase [22].
